title: Form 2220 (2025), Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Corporations

passages.question: What underpayment rate applies to the September to December 2025 period?
passages.excerpt: Number of days on line 20 after 6/30/2025 and before 10/1/2025 ... x 7% (0.07) ... Number of days on line 20 after 9/30/2025 and before 1/1/2026 ... x 7% (0.07)
